```{r}
#| eval: false
# devtools::install_github("rspatial/geodata") 
library(geodata)
future_clim <- cmip6_world(
  lon = -5.2833,
  lat = 6.8167,
  var = "bio", # bioclim
  res = 10, # 10' res
  model = "BCC-CSM2-MR", # GCM
  ssp = "245", # SSP
  time = "2041-2060", # horizon
  path = "data" # out dir
)
```
